1 7:51 What do comedians tend to do before performing, and why??They practise their material before performing on big stages. This helps them test what works and build confidence.
2 8:26 What does "practising safe sets" mean for everyday situations??It means thinking about how a joke will make others feel, never punching down, and only joking about things close to your own experience.
3 8:43 How can people climb back up the humour cliff??By getting to know their humour style, looking for truth in everyday life, making small shifts from transactional to human, practising safe sets, and choosing to live on the precipice of a smile.
4 9:09 What connection is there between humour and love??The speakers suggest that where humour exists, love is not far behind. Humour creates connection, joy, and closeness — the foundations of love in both personal and professional relationships.
